source_row.source_name: College of Sexual and Reproductive Healthcare (CoSRH)
source_row.extraction_instructions: iMIS Cloud site (client-side iPart) at /Public/Events; requires a real browser for both listing and detail (raw httpx only returns header/footer, and /api/Event returns 401 anonymously). Listing cards give only title + Event_Display.aspx?EventKey=... booking_url; all real fields (dates, venue, pricing, CPD) come from the detail page's standard 'When'/'Where'/'AdditionalInfoHtmlData' block IDs. Pricing appears in 3 shapes (matrix In-Person/Online table with optional colspan group rows, plain 2-col table, or prose 'Label: £NNN' lines) or not at all when booking requires member sign-in. Booking always requires sign-in, so is_sold_out can never be observed anonymously.

concerns: is_sold_out is always False by design: booking on every event requires account sign-in and no anonymous 'sold out' state is ever rendered for this site. If CoSRH later exposes a public sold-out badge, revisit.

3 of 9 live events (Menopause Care course x2, CoSRH AGM/Trainer Conference in some cases) publish no pricing at all — booking/pricing is only shown after member sign-in. pricing_tiers correctly comes back [] rather than fabricated; the audit gate's generic parse_pricing_tables() would also find 0 tiers here so it should not false-flag these as MISSING.

CoSRH AGM (event_type classified 'workshop' via the agm keyword) is a members-only administrative/voting meeting with no CPD value — kept as a real dated event per the RCPE 'College Meetings & Ceremonies' precedent in PLAYBOOK.md, but it may be worth excluding from the directory entirely if it looks noisy in production; flagging rather than deciding unilaterally.
Only 9 upcoming events were live on the listing at test time (recon expected 10); no pagination/load-more control exists so this is treated as the full current list, not a truncation bug.

event_type is entirely a title-keyword heuristic (_classify_event_type) since the site has no listing badge/category field surfaced on cards; if CoSRH adds titles that don't contain 'conference'/'course'/'assessment'/'agm'/'training' this could default incorrectly to 'conference'.

Every live event this wave used the standard iMIS ciEventDisplay block IDs (_WhenData/_AddressData/_AdditionalInfoHtmlData); if CoSRH ever runs an event through a different iMIS template (e.g. a third-party Eventbrite-style embed like RCPE's 'External Events'), those selectors would need a fallback — not observed in this source's live inventory.

Specialty defaults to a hardcoded 'Sexual & Reproductive Health' fallback when neither the LLM nor the shared specialty_classifier keyword list matches (e.g. 'CoSRH Trainer Conference') — reasonable for a single-society source but worth knowing this isn't the generic classifier's own output.
